environment.electronFlags: CDP loopback; DNS denied except 127.0.0.1; background networking disabled; GPU remains default

methodology.cold: Fresh main/renderer each run, copying only migrated SQLite into a fresh profile; no OS cache flush; migration/copy excluded.
methodology.ready: Exact project rows, project identity, chapter count, selected full body, saved-state, linked Agent result and reload-success status; conditions survive two animation frames.
methodology.interaction: CDP native mouse/key/insertText only. Scroll/hit-test preparation precedes each click timer; polling 20ms plus CDP/paint overhead is included.
methodology.edit: One append at end of last chapter. Existing debounced autosave without blur; exact persisted body verified with read-only preload data.load.
methodology.observation: Full data.load stays inside Electron; only compact checks return. Readbacks outside UI timers except explicitly named readback metrics. No pure-function UI substitute.
methodology.refresh: Existing seeded latest Agent run + explicit native confirmation, actual reload status, equal persisted revision; no simulated external writer.
methodology.statistics: Nearest-rank p50/p95 over passed measured runs only. With n=3/5 p95 is max, not a stable population tail estimate. Warmup/raw failures retained.
methodology.cleanup: Browser.close plus owned PID inventory termination/verification; startup failure uses owned taskkill /T, never executable-name killing.
methodology.safety: New synthetic profile only; sanitized child environment; blank credentials, local reject endpoint for every model role, no AI commands; no native rebuild/swap.

sizes.overlay: One completed Agent run linked to final job/draft/commits; reject-only AI settings; raw shared fixture unchanged.
